name: Flashbacks Bar
address: Shop 9 & 10, Marine building, Main St, Plettenberg Bay, 6600, South Africa
description_short: Lively Main Street bar with cold beers, sports on big screens, and a proper local vibe.
description_long:
Tucked into the Marine building on Plettenberg Bay's Main Street, Flashbacks Bar has been a local favourite for years. It's the kind of place where you pop in for one drink and end up staying for the evening — cold beers on tap, a full bar, and a relaxed atmosphere that welcomes everyone from surfers to families.

The menu covers all the pub classics done well: burgers, pizzas, and proper bar snacks that hit the spot after a day at the beach. Multiple big screens show live sports, making it a solid choice for catching the rugby or football with mates. The indoor-outdoor setup means you can grab a table on the pavement or settle in at the bar.

It's a no-fuss spot in the heart of Plett that locals rely on for dependable food, good times, and a soundtrack of classic rock. Whether you're after a quick bite, a few drinks, or somewhere to watch the game, Flashbacks delivers without pretension.
